extracted.intended_audience: general public / anyone needing to convert between metric and imperial length units
extracted.subtask_description: Explains how to convert a length measured in centimeters to feet (and vice versa) using the exact conversion factor, with definitions of the units and a worked example.

rubrics_metrics.name: Conversion factor (1 foot = 30.48 centimeters)
rubrics_metrics.description: One foot is equal to 30.48 centimeters.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This exact factor is the basis for all conversions between centimeters and feet. Use it either by dividing centimeters by 30.48 to get feet or multiplying feet by 30.48 to get centimeters.

rubrics_metrics.name: Method: convert centimeters to feet
rubrics_metrics.description: To convert centimeters to feet, you need to divide the number of centimeters by 30.48.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example provided: 150 cm ÷ 30.48 ≈ 4.92 feet. Use the division method for any cm value to obtain feet; carry desired decimal precision as appropriate for your context.

rubrics_metrics.name: Method: convert feet to centimeters
rubrics_metrics.description: If you have a measurement in feet and you want to convert it to centimeters, you would multiply the number of feet by 30.48.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Multiply feet by 30.48 to obtain centimeters. No inventive steps required—use the exact factor for precise conversion, and round only as needed for reporting.

rubrics_metrics.name: Centimeter definition
rubrics_metrics.description: A centimeter is a unit of length in the metric system (SI), equal to one hundredth of a meter.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used for measuring small distances (length of objects, height of individuals). In conversion terms, one centimeter is approximately equal to 0.0328 feet.

rubrics_metrics.name: Foot definition
rubrics_metrics.description: A foot is a unit of length in the imperial system, defined as 12 inches and used primarily in the United States and a few other countries.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The page notes the foot's historical origin (based on a human foot) and its use in construction, architecture, and sports. Knowing that 1 foot = 12 inches can help when converting between other imperial units.

rubrics_metrics.name: Quick approximate equivalence for mental math
rubrics_metrics.description: One centimeter is approximately equal to 0.0328 feet.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use this approximate value for quick estimates or mental calculations when exact precision is not required. For precise work, use the 30.48 factor and perform division/multiplication.

rubrics_metrics.name: Worked example
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The example demonstrates the division method and shows typical numeric rounding in a simple case; follow the same steps for other values.
